about_the_game:
High Fructose isn’t your average arena shooter — these are giant, semi-open battlefields, procedurally generated to keep every run fresh. Dash, jump, wall-run, and unleash your arsenal across layered, sprawling environments built for full movement freedom, exploration, and chaos.
Choose from various ninjas such as a Fox, Elephant, Wolverine, and Monkey.

                           

 

🍉 Imagine Fruit Ninja meets Ghostrunner with Guns

You’re a superpowered animal warrior wielding up to 12 weapons, bending time, and turning hordes of mutant fruit into juicy pulp.

🍇 Key Features

⚔️ Procedural Arenas
Battle in semi-open, procedurally generated orchards with fresh layouts every run.

🧃 Culinary Combat
Slice enemies in the right recipe combos to earn bonus XP, coins, or devastating power-ups.

🔫 Juiced Arsenal
Equip everything from swords and wands to AK-47s and panda-firing cannons. Plus: your main melee weapon for up-close chaos.

⚡ Rapid-Fire Action
Dash, slow time, and fight through intense 30-minute runs packed with nonstop mayhem.

👹 Mutant Fruit Enemies
Face off against evolving monstrosities—like the Banana Snake, Cherry Cannons, and Dragonfruit Dragons.

🛍️ Between-Wave Upgrades
Earn coins mid-run to unlock weapons, perks, and game-changing gear in the shop.

🌱 Persistent Power-Ups
Collect seeds to grow stronger with every run—unlock permanent upgrades and master new recipes.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: i3 4130
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 660
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Ghostrunner meets Fruit Ninja in this fast-paced FPS roguelite. Slice mutant fruit, slow time, and unleash chaos with wild weapons—like a cannon that shoots panda bears. Dash, combo, and complete recipes as four animal warriors in a rotting orchard gone wrong.
supported_languages:
English*, French, German, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Swedish, Turkish
*languages with full audio support
